testingSummary: All 12 assertions for the compositing-infrastructure milestone passed validation through automated unit tests and code verification. The implementation provides: (1) CompositingDescriptorSet with proper viewport count validation (max 8), descriptor set layout matching WGSL shader expectations (set 2, binding 0), and runtime texture update capability; (2) CompositePass template with fluent builder API, proper resource dependency tracking, and frame graph integration; (3) ViewportRect structure with shader-ready [x,y,z,w] format; (4) Compositing WGSL shader that compiles successfully and implements fullscreen rendering, texture array sampling, and alpha blending. Unit tests cover all major APIs and edge cases. Build succeeds without errors.
